ORAL ORDER 1. Present application is preferred by the petitioners under Article 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking quashing of FIR No.11993012240045 of 2024 dated 30.08.2024 registered with Mahila Police Station Kachchh East, Kachchh East-Gandhidham for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 114 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Heard learned Advocate for the petitioners and learned APP for the Respondent - State.

sentences.text: Learned Advocate Mr. Remal Soni appears and states that he has received instructions to appear on behalf of the Respondent No.3 (Original Complainant).
Registry to accept the Vakalatnama of learned Advocate Mr. Remal Soni and place it on record.
3. Rule. Learned APP waives service of notice of Rule for and on behalf of the respondent nos.01 and 02.

Learned advocate Mr. Remal Soni appearing for the Respondent No.3 (Original NEUTRAL Ravishbhai Nareshbhai Agrawal vs State Of Gujarat on 24 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127649934/

4. Learned Advocate for the petitioners has submitted that the matter has been amicably settled between the parties and they are now not willing to proceed with the complaint any further.
5. Leaned Advocate Mr. Remal Soni appearing on behalf of Respondent No.03 (Original Complainant) has placed on record duly sworn in Affidavit dated 07.02.2026.
The same is ordered to be taken on record.
Learned Advocate has submitted that matter has been amicably settled between the parties and there is no objection if present application is allowed.

The affidavit reads thus:
"2. It is submitted that I have no objection if First Information Report registered with Mahila Police Station, East Kachchh, Gandhidham vide Crime Register No.
11993012240045 of 2024 pending as Criminal Case No. 6175 of 2024 and proceedings are quashed pending against the petitioners as we have arrived to amicable settlement."
6. Considering averments made in the Affidavit as also the submissions made by the learned Advocates for the respective parties, the present application deserves to be allowed and is hereby allowed.

ORAL ORDER 1. Present application is preferred by the petitioners under Article 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking quashing of FIR No.11993012240045 of 2024 dated 30.08.2024 registered with Mahila Police Station Kachchh East, Kachchh East-Gandhidham for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 114 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Heard learned Advocate for the petitioners and learned APP for the Respondent - State.
